cc34a9f8-4ab0-48c6-ab8f-ad8e27f133da.data: During Metaphase, chromosomes line up neatly end-to-end along the center (equator) of the cell, with the mitotic spindle fibers attaching to each of the sister chromatids.

9d7713e1-d14a-415b-b9db-8baf38f33873.data: In Anaphase, the sister chromatids are pulled apart by the mitotic spindle, with one chromatid being pulled to one pole and the other chromatid to the opposite pole.
